sources.title: GitHub - ggml-org/llama.cpp: LLM inference in C/C++ · GitHub
sources.snippet: Custom CUDA kernels for running LLMs on NVIDIA GPUs (support for AMD GPUs via HIP and Moore Threads GPUs via MUSA) Vulkan and SYCL backend support CPU+GPU hybrid inference to partially accelerate models larger than the total VRAM capacity The llama.cpp project is build on top of the ggml library.

sources.title: Run LLMs on Intel® GPUs Using llama.cpp
sources.snippet: The newly developed SYCL backend in llama.cpp—a light, open source LLM framework—enables developers to deploy on the full spectrum of Intel GPUs.
